announcements_texts_check.name: announcements_texts_check
announcements_texts_check.value: char_length("announcements"."title_is") between 1 and 80 and char_length("announcements"."title_en") between 1 and 80 and char_length("announcements"."message_is") between 1 and 1000 and char_length("announcements"."message_en") between 1 and 1000

bookings_deadlines_check.name: bookings_deadlines_check
bookings_deadlines_check.value: ("bookings"."status" <> 'requested' or "bookings"."expires_at" is not null) and ("bookings"."status" <> 'accepted' or "bookings"."payment_due_at" is not null)

messages_body_check.name: messages_body_check
messages_body_check.value: ("messages"."kind" = 'text') = ("messages"."body" is not null) and char_length("messages"."body") between 1 and 1000 or ("messages"."erased_at" is not null and "messages"."body" is null)

messages_key_check.name: messages_key_check
messages_key_check.value: ("messages"."erased_at" is null or "messages"."kind" <> 'system') and (("messages"."kind" = 'text') = ("messages"."key" is null) or ("messages"."erased_at" is not null and "messages"."key" is null and "messages"."params" is null))

messages_sent_as_check.name: messages_sent_as_check
messages_sent_as_check.value: "messages"."sent_as" is null or ("messages"."erased_at" is not null and "messages"."sent_as" in ('driver', 'passenger'))

meeting_point_issues_resolved_check.name: meeting_point_issues_resolved_check
meeting_point_issues_resolved_check.value: ("meeting_point_issues"."status" = 'resolved') = ("meeting_point_issues"."resolved_at" is not null) and ("meeting_point_issues"."status" = 'resolved') = ("meeting_point_issues"."resolution_note" is not null) and ("meeting_point_issues"."status" = 'open' or "meeting_point_issues"."reporter_id" is null)

meeting_points_season_check.name: meeting_points_season_check
meeting_points_season_check.value: ("meeting_points"."season_start_month" is null and "meeting_points"."season_end_month" is null) or ("meeting_points"."season_start_month" between 1 and 12 and "meeting_points"."season_end_month" between 1 and 12)

meeting_points_shelter_hours_check.name: meeting_points_shelter_hours_check
meeting_points_shelter_hours_check.value: case when "meeting_points"."shelter_hours" is null then true when jsonb_typeof("meeting_points"."shelter_hours") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("meeting_points"."shelter_hours") = 7 else false end

disputes_decided_check.name: disputes_decided_check
disputes_decided_check.value: ("disputes"."outcome" is null) = ("disputes"."decided_at" is null) and ("disputes"."outcome" is null) = ("disputes"."decided_by" is null)

disputes_kind_outcome_check.name: disputes_kind_outcome_check
disputes_kind_outcome_check.value: "disputes"."outcome" is null or ("disputes"."kind" = 'no_show' and "disputes"."outcome" in ('stands', 'rode', 'left_behind')) or ("disputes"."kind" = 'driver_absent' and "disputes"."outcome" in ('stands', 'rode', 'passenger_absent'))

data_exports_ready_check.name: data_exports_ready_check
data_exports_ready_check.value: ("data_exports"."ready_at" is null) = ("data_exports"."expires_at" is null) and ("data_exports"."file" is null or "data_exports"."ready_at" is not null)

moderation_actions_rule_check.name: moderation_actions_rule_check
moderation_actions_rule_check.value: ("moderation_actions"."kind" = 'reinstatement') = ("moderation_actions"."rule" is null) and ("moderation_actions"."rule" is null or "moderation_actions"."rule" in ('safety', 'harassment', 'discrimination', 'scam', 'false_info', 'offensive', 'not_as_listed', 'reliability', 'other'))

moderation_actions_content_check.name: moderation_actions_content_check
moderation_actions_content_check.value: ("moderation_actions"."content_kind" is null) = ("moderation_actions"."content_id" is null) and ("moderation_actions"."content_kind" is null or "moderation_actions"."content_kind" in ('message', 'review', 'trip_note', 'about', 'trip', 'booking'))

moderation_actions_appeal_check.name: moderation_actions_appeal_check
moderation_actions_appeal_check.value: ("moderation_actions"."appeal_text" is null) = ("moderation_actions"."appealed_at" is null) and ("moderation_actions"."appeal_answered_at" is null or "moderation_actions"."appealed_at" is not null) and ("moderation_actions"."appeal_answered_at" is null) = ("moderation_actions"."appeal_outcome" is null) and ("moderation_actions"."appeal_answered_at" is null) = ("moderation_actions"."appeal_answer" is null)

reports_closed_check.name: reports_closed_check
reports_closed_check.value: ("reports"."status" = 'closed') = ("reports"."closed_at" is not null) and ("reports"."status" = 'closed') = ("reports"."outcome" is not null)

trips_cancelled_by_check.name: trips_cancelled_by_check
trips_cancelled_by_check.value: "trips"."cancelled_by" is null or ("trips"."cancelled_at" is not null and "trips"."cancelled_by" in ('driver', 'operator'))

trips_times_check.name: trips_times_check
trips_times_check.value: ("trips"."departs_at" is null) = ("trips"."arrives_at" is null) and ("trips"."status" = 'draft' or "trips"."departs_at" is null or "trips"."departs_at" < "trips"."arrives_at")

trips_published_check.name: trips_published_check
trips_published_check.value: "trips"."status" = 'draft' or ("trips"."vehicle_id" is not null and "trips"."departs_at" is not null and "trips"."published_at" is not null)

vehicles_registration_check.name: vehicles_registration_check
vehicles_registration_check.value: "vehicles"."registration" is null or (char_length("vehicles"."registration") between 2 and 8 and "vehicles"."registration" = upper("vehicles"."registration") and "vehicles"."registration" !~ '[[:space:]-]')
